content: Autofill best practice: require unlock before autofill, prefer explicit fill-on-click/shortcut over silent auto-fill, no auto-submit. Domain matching defaults to base-domain with optional equivalent-domain linking and strict host matching as an option. Untrusted iframe fills should be blocked by default. Context-menu 'scan 2FA/TOTP from QR' is an expected power feature (Keeper ships it).
